id: title:Gilbert09:classify exhausted 5xx retries as self recovering

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Polar API 5xx status codes to the set of transient, retryable errors for warehouse ingestion, alongside the existing 429/500/502/503/504 status codes. This could help recover from transient Polar outages without failing the entire warehouse ingestion job.

While the implementation and shared helper integration are not visible, the classification criteria and test assertions demonstrate a substantive, bounded capability improvement for warehouse ingestion reliability.
